scope: Targeted rest, cooldown and health-only potion checks. No full regression rerun.

targeted_tests.coverage: Full recovery after 15 seconds, other cooldowns unchanged, PvE/PvP gates, cancellation without reward or cooldown, shared 60-second cooldown and exact boundary, old saves/reconnect/restart/owner_delta, published rest fields.
targeted_tests.run_note: Initial run passed five cases; the persistence case encountered a Windows SQLite fixture cleanup error. The test now closes its backup connection explicitly; rerunning that case passed.

targeted_tests.coverage: Health-only catalog, merchant/quest/loot sources, preserved health drop probability, retired mana stacks removed from inventory and depot, legacy counts imported once, Q preserved or repaired, mana and R potion commands rejected.
Selected existing health potion purchase, sale, Q binding/use, cooldown and legacy migration checks.
Published rest rules, combat/active/dead gates, full recovery defaults and the final fractional second of cooldown.

source_review: HUD has one potion button Q; R invokes restUI.open with existing typing and repeat guards.
Rest has no choice dialog, keeps the animation and above-character progress, and displays the cooldown on its button.
The inventory offers Q assignment only; mana potion controls and shop rows are removed.
The remaining active-backend mana_potion identifier references detect retired items for cleanup and rejection.
deployment: Local source and packages only. No live database edited, push or deployment performed.
